description: Bullrun's company risk read for one stock: a 0-100 composite risk score and six mechanism dials (market expectation, operating pressure, cash conversion, leverage & coverage, competitive position, concentration) with band (Contained/Normal/Elevated/Stretched/Acute), direction vs the prior reading, the driving input and a plain-English explanation; plus filing-derived risk factors (severity, mechanism, source filing), identified supplier concentration (share of cost base covered, HHI, sole-source count, top supplier share) and recent material events. Use for "how risky is X", "what are the main risks for X", "is X's supply chain concentrated", or before adding a stock to a portfolio. Pair with get_company_relationships for the named competitors/suppliers/customers behind the concentration dial. Bands describe measured strain, never a buy/sell view. Read-only.

detail.description: summary = scores, bands, drivers and explanations; full = also every per-input term behind each category score.

include.description: Modules to return. dials = composite + six mechanism dials (market expectation, operating pressure, cash conversion, leverage, competitive position, concentration); risk_factors = filing-derived risk factors (10-K/annual report) with severity and mechanism; supplier_exposure = identified supplier spend concentration; events = recent restructuring/legal/supply/recall events; headline = latest news headline beside the dials. Default: dials, risk_factors, supplier_exposure.

maxEvents.description: Max recent company events to return, most severe first.

maxRiskFactors.description: Max filing risk factors to return, most severe first.

ticker.description: Bullrun ticker, e.g. "AAPL", "ASML", "NESN", "6324.T" or "0700.HK". Bullrun tickers: US and most European listings use the plain local symbol (AAPL, BMW, NESN, ABBN); most Asian and Indian listings keep their exchange suffix (Tokyo 6324.T, Hong Kong 0700.HK, Shanghai 600519.SS, Shenzhen 000001.SZ, Taiwan 2330.TW, Korea 000100.KS, Singapore D05.SI, India RELIANCE.NS), but some Japanese and Korean large caps are plain codes (Toyota 7203, Samsung 005930). Either form is resolved automatically when exactly one listing matches; use search_stocks to find a ticker by company name or ISIN.
